'''2009 US West Nationals Day 1 Chris Schoenthal LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Schoenthal]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Knock-Knock
* '''Username:''' imrahil327
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
